## SIMOA Publication
This is the code I will use to prepare my SIMOA dataset for publication. It ill 
largely follow the same pattern as my MSc code but I will make some changes to 
address the feedback that was left such as factor analysis for the study 
composites and exploring the non-linearity of DBAS Medication.

## Load data
```{r}
library(readr)

SIMOA <- read_csv("SIMOA Report.csv")
View(SIMOA)
```

## Eligibility
```{r}
#| label: Eligible Participants
######
# Participant Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria
# 1. Age ≥65 years (age_cat == 1, or age_cat == 0 with age >= 65)
# 2. Selected at least one of 14 specified BZRAs
# 3. Answered discontinuation outcome (freq_dich)
# 4. Canadian resident (prov_terr != 14)
######

library(dplyr)

# Ensure dplyr functions take priority (safety check)
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate

# Original count
n_original <- nrow(SIMOA)

# After age filtering (age_cat == 1 means 65+)
SIMOA_age_filtered <- SIMOA %>%
  filter(age_cat == 1 | (age_cat == 0 & age >= 65))
n_after_age <- nrow(SIMOA_age_filtered)

# After c_sp filtering (selecting those who indicated at least one of 14 BZRAs)
SIMOA_c_sp_filtered <- SIMOA_age_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    bzra_selected = rowSums(across(starts_with("c_sp___"), ~ .x == 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(bzra_selected > 0) %>%
  select(-bzra_selected)
n_after_c_sp <- nrow(SIMOA_c_sp_filtered)

# After freq_dich filtering
SIMOA_scrn_filtered <- SIMOA_c_sp_filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(freq_dich))
n_after_scrn <- nrow(SIMOA_scrn_filtered)

# Remove non-Canadian participants (prov_terr == 14)
n_before_prov <- n_after_scrn
SIMOA <- SIMOA_scrn_filtered %>%
  filter(prov_terr != 14)
n_after_prov <- nrow(SIMOA)

# Calculate how many were removed
n_removed_prov <- n_before_prov - n_after_prov

# Summary output
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAMPLE INCLUSION/EXCLUSION SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Original sample size:", n_original, "\n")
cat("After age filtering (≥65 years):", n_after_age, " (", round(n_after_age / n_original * 100, 1), "% retained)\n")
cat("After BZRA confirmation:", n_after_c_sp, " (", round(n_after_c_sp / n_after_age * 100, 1), "% retained)\n")
cat("After outcome availability:", n_after_scrn, " (", round(n_after_scrn / n_after_c_sp * 100, 1), "% retained)\n")
cat("After Canadian residency filter:", n_after_prov, " (", round(n_after_prov / n_after_scrn * 100, 1), "% retained)\n")
cat("Non-Canadian participants removed:", n_removed_prov, "\n\n")

# Participant flow (CONSORT-style)
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PARTICIPANT FLOW\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Initial sample:                    ", n_original, "\n")
cat("  ↓ Excluded (age <65):            ", n_original - n_after_age, "\n")
cat("Eligible by age:                   ", n_after_age, "\n")
cat("  ↓ Excluded (no BZRA use):        ", n_after_age - n_after_c_sp, "\n")
cat("Confirmed BZRA users:              ", n_after_c_sp, "\n")
cat("  ↓ Excluded (missing outcome):    ", n_after_c_sp - n_after_scrn, "\n")
cat("With outcome data:                 ", n_after_scrn, "\n")
cat("  ↓ Excluded (non-Canadian):       ", n_removed_prov, "\n")
cat("FINAL ANALYTIC SAMPLE:             ", n_after_prov, "\n\n")

# Total exclusion rate
pct_excluded_total <- 100 * (1 - n_after_prov / n_original)
cat("Total exclusion rate:", round(pct_excluded_total, 1), "%\n\n")

if(pct_excluded_total > 50) {
  cat("⚠️  More than 50% of sample excluded - verify inclusion criteria\n\n")
}

# Save exclusion summary for manuscript
exclusion_summary <- data.frame(
  Step = c(
    "1. Initial sample",
    "2. Age ≥65 years",
    "3. BZRA use confirmed",
    "4. Outcome available",
    "5. Canadian resident",
    "FINAL SAMPLE"
  ),
  N = c(n_original, n_after_age, n_after_c_sp, n_after_scrn, n_after_prov, n_after_prov),
  N_Excluded = c(
    NA,
    n_original - n_after_age,
    n_after_age - n_after_c_sp,
    n_after_c_sp - n_after_scrn,
    n_removed_prov,
    NA
  ),
  Pct_Retained = c(
    100,
    round(100 * n_after_age / n_original, 1),
    round(100 * n_after_c_sp / n_original, 1),
    round(100 * n_after_scrn / n_original, 1),
    round(100 * n_after_prov / n_original, 1),
    round(100 * n_after_prov / n_original, 1)
  )
)

write.csv(exclusion_summary, "sample_exclusion_flowchart.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: sample_exclusion_flowchart.csv\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ Eligibility filtering complete\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```


## Personality Missingness
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 4: EARLY DROPOUT DIAGNOSTICS
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Identify participants who dropped out before completing personality
#          scales, and test whether dropouts differ from completers on observed
#          pre-dropout variables.
#
# Key assumption: DBAS is the first personality scale in survey order.
#   Confirmed via Step 0: all participants missing dbas1 are missing the
#   entire personality block (100% across all scales).
#==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("EARLY DROPOUT DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

library(naniar)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 0: Validate dropout proxy
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("STEP 0: Validating dropout proxy\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

dropout_check <- SIMOA %>%
  filter(is.na(dbas1)) %>%
  summarise(
    n_missing_dbas1         = n(),
    pct_also_missing_dbas16 = round(100 * mean(is.na(dbas_16)), 1),
    pct_also_missing_surps1 = round(100 * mean(is.na(surps1)), 1),
    pct_also_missing_ciss1  = round(100 * mean(is.na(ciss1)), 1),
    pct_also_missing_bfi    = round(100 * mean(is.na(reserved)), 1)
  )

cat("Among participants missing dbas1 (n =", dropout_check$n_missing_dbas1, "):\n")
cat("  Also missing dbas_16:", dropout_check$pct_also_missing_dbas16, "%\n")
cat("  Also missing surps1: ", dropout_check$pct_also_missing_surps1, "%\n")
cat("  Also missing ciss1:  ", dropout_check$pct_also_missing_ciss1, "%\n")
cat("  Also missing BFI:    ", dropout_check$pct_also_missing_bfi, "%\n\n")

partial_check <- SIMOA %>%
  filter(!is.na(dbas1)) %>%
  summarise(
    n_completed_dbas1        = n(),
    pct_missing_later_surps1 = round(100 * mean(is.na(surps1)), 1),
    pct_missing_later_ciss1  = round(100 * mean(is.na(ciss1)), 1),
    pct_missing_later_bfi    = round(100 * mean(is.na(reserved)), 1)
  )

cat("Among participants who completed dbas1 (n =", partial_check$n_completed_dbas1, "):\n")
cat("  Missing surps1: ", partial_check$pct_missing_later_surps1, "%\n")
cat("  Missing ciss1:  ", partial_check$pct_missing_later_ciss1, "%\n")
cat("  Missing BFI:    ", partial_check$pct_missing_later_bfi, "%\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 1: Define dropout indicator
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("STEP 1: Defining dropout indicator\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

SIMOA <- SIMOA %>%
  mutate(
    dropout_before_personality = ifelse(is.na(dbas1), 1, 0)
  )

cat("Dropout before personality section:\n")
print(table(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality, useNA = "ifany"))
cat(sprintf("\n  Dropouts:   %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 1),
            100 * mean(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 1)))
cat(sprintf("  Completers: %d (%.1f%%)\n\n",
            sum(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 0),
            100 * mean(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 0)))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 2: Compare dropouts vs completers
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("STEP 2: Comparing dropouts vs completers on pre-dropout variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Ensure correct types
truly_continuous <- c("age", "med_quant", "osss_3_score", "phq2_score")
truly_categorical <- c("sex", "gender", "prov_terr", "education",
                       "income", "employment", "driving_freq")

# Coerce continuous vars
for (var in truly_continuous[truly_continuous %in% names(SIMOA)]) {
  SIMOA[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(SIMOA[[var]]))
}

# --- Continuous: Wilcoxon ---
cat("Continuous variables (Wilcoxon rank-sum):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

continuous_results <- list()

for (var in truly_continuous[truly_continuous %in% names(SIMOA)]) {
  completer_vals <- SIMOA[[var]][SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 0]
  dropout_vals   <- SIMOA[[var]][SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 1]
  if (sum(!is.na(completer_vals)) < 5 || sum(!is.na(dropout_vals)) < 5) next
  test <- wilcox.test(completer_vals, dropout_vals, exact = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("  %-20s Completer Mdn=%.1f  Dropout Mdn=%.1f  W=%.1f  p=%.4f %s\n",
              var,
              median(completer_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
              median(dropout_vals,   na.rm = TRUE),
              test$statistic, test$p.value,
              ifelse(test$p.value < .05, "*", "")))
  continuous_results[[var]] <- data.frame(
    Variable         = var,
    Completer_Median = median(completer_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dropout_Median   = median(dropout_vals,   na.rm = TRUE),
    W                = round(test$statistic, 1),
    p_value          = round(test$p.value, 4),
    sig              = ifelse(test$p.value < .05, "*", "")
  )
}
cat("\n")

# --- Categorical: Chi-square or Fisher's exact ---
cat("Categorical variables (chi-square or Fisher's exact):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

categorical_results <- list()

for (var in truly_categorical[truly_categorical %in% names(SIMOA)]) {
  tbl <- table(SIMOA[[var]], SIMOA$dropout_before_personality, useNA = "no")
  if (nrow(tbl) < 2) next
  expected <- tryCatch(chisq.test(tbl)$expected, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(expected)) next
  if (min(expected) < 5) {
    test <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
    cat(sprintf("  %-20s Fisher's p=%.4f %s  [small expected counts]\n",
                var, test$p.value,
                ifelse(test$p.value < .05, "*", "")))
    categorical_results[[var]] <- data.frame(
      Variable = var,
      Test     = "Fisher's exact",
      p_value  = round(test$p.value, 4),
      sig      = ifelse(test$p.value < .05, "*", "")
    )
  } else {
    test <- chisq.test(tbl)
    cat(sprintf("  %-20s χ²(%d)=%.3f  p=%.4f %s\n",
                var, test$parameter, test$statistic, test$p.value,
                ifelse(test$p.value < .05, "*", "")))
    categorical_results[[var]] <- data.frame(
      Variable = var,
      Test     = "Chi-square",
      p_value  = round(test$p.value, 4),
      sig      = ifelse(test$p.value < .05, "*", "")
    )
  }
}
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3: Outcome-dropout relationship
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("STEP 3: Outcome-dropout relationship\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

outcome_var <- "freq_dich"

if (outcome_var %in% names(SIMOA)) {

  tbl <- table(SIMOA[[outcome_var]], SIMOA$dropout_before_personality)
  cat("Dropout status by", outcome_var, ":\n")
  print(addmargins(tbl))
  cat("\n")

  expected <- tryCatch(chisq.test(tbl)$expected, error = function(e) NULL)
  min_expected <- if (!is.null(expected)) round(min(expected), 2) else NA
  cat(sprintf("Minimum expected cell count: %.2f\n\n", min_expected))

  if (!is.na(min_expected) && min_expected < 5) {
    cat("Expected counts too small for chi-square. Using Fisher's exact test.\n\n")
    test <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
    cat(sprintf("Fisher's exact test: p = %.4f\n\n", test$p.value))
    p_val <- test$p.value
  } else {
    test <- chisq.test(tbl)
    cat(sprintf("Chi-square: χ²(%d) = %.3f, p = %.4f\n\n",
                test$parameter, test$statistic, test$p.value))
    p_val <- test$p.value
  }

  if (p_val < 0.05) {
    cat("⚠️  Dropout is associated with outcome status.\n")
    cat("→  MNAR signal: who dropped out depends on the outcome.\n")
    cat("→  Sensitivity analyses are essential.\n\n")
    outcome_related <- TRUE
  } else {
    cat("✓  Dropout is not significantly associated with outcome.\n")
    cat("→  MAR assumption more defensible.\n\n")
    outcome_related <- FALSE
  }

} else {
  cat("Outcome variable not found.\n\n")
  outcome_related <- NA
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: Multivariable logistic regression
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("STEP 4: Multivariable logistic regression — predictors of dropout\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")
cat("Identifies which pre-dropout variables independently predict dropout.\n\n")

all_pred_vars <- c(truly_continuous, truly_categorical)
available_preds <- all_pred_vars[all_pred_vars %in% names(SIMOA)]

formula_str <- paste("dropout_before_personality ~",
                     paste(available_preds, collapse = " + "))

dropout_model <- tryCatch({
  glm(as.formula(formula_str), data = SIMOA, family = binomial())
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("⚠️  Full model failed:", e$message, "\n")
  cat("→  Falling back to age + sex + education.\n\n")
  tryCatch(
    glm(dropout_before_personality ~ age + sex + education,
        data = SIMOA, family = binomial()),
    error = function(e2) { cat("⚠️  Fallback also failed.\n"); NULL }
  )
})

if (!is.null(dropout_model)) {
  dropout_results <- broom::tidy(dropout_model) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      OR       = round(exp(estimate), 3),
      CI_lower = round(exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error), 3),
      CI_upper = round(exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error), 3),
      p_value  = round(p.value, 4),
      sig      = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")
    ) %>%
    arrange(p.value) %>%
    select(term, OR, CI_lower, CI_upper, p_value, sig)

  print(dropout_results)
  cat("\n")

  sig_predictors <- dropout_results %>%
    filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
    pull(term)

  if (length(sig_predictors) > 0) {
    cat("Independent predictors of dropout (p < .05):\n")
    for (p in sig_predictors) cat("  •", p, "\n")
    cat("\n→  Include these variables in your imputation model.\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("No independent predictors of dropout at p < .05.\n\n")
  }

} else {
  sig_predictors <- character(0)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5: Overall summary
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DROPOUT ANALYSIS SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat(sprintf("Total N: %d\n", nrow(SIMOA)))
cat(sprintf("Dropouts (missing personality section): %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality),
            100 * mean(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality)))
cat(sprintf("Completers: %d (%.1f%%)\n\n",
            sum(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 0),
            100 * mean(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 0)))

cat("Significant group differences: ")
any_sig_continuous   <- any(sapply(continuous_results,   function(x) x$sig == "*"))
any_sig_categorical  <- any(sapply(categorical_results,  function(x) x$sig == "*"))
if (!any_sig_continuous && !any_sig_categorical && length(sig_predictors) == 0) {
  cat("None\n\n")
} else {
  cat("See above\n\n")
}

cat("Outcome-dropout association: ")
if (is.na(outcome_related)) {
  cat("Not tested\n\n")
} else if (outcome_related) {
  cat("Significant — MNAR concern\n\n")
} else {
  cat("Not significant — MAR plausible\n\n")
}

cat("OVERALL ASSESSMENT:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

if (!outcome_related && !any_sig_continuous && !any_sig_categorical) {
  cat("✓  Pattern consistent with MCAR.\n")
  cat("   Dropouts do not differ from completers on any measured variable,\n")
  cat("   and dropout is unrelated to outcome status.\n\n")
  cat("RECOMMENDATIONS:\n")
  cat("  1. Complete-case analysis is the primary approach and is defensible.\n")
  cat("  2. Multiple imputation may be used as a sensitivity check.\n")
  cat("  3. Note in limitations that MCAR cannot be formally proven —\n")
  cat("     unmeasured variables may still predict dropout.\n\n")
} else if (outcome_related) {
  cat("⚠️  MNAR concern: dropout associated with outcome.\n\n")
  cat("RECOMMENDATIONS:\n")
  cat("  1. Multiple imputation is necessary but interpret cautiously.\n")
  cat("  2. Conduct pattern-mixture or tipping point sensitivity analyses.\n")
  cat("  3. Discuss MNAR as a limitation.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("~  MAR plausible: some variables predict dropout.\n\n")
  cat("RECOMMENDATIONS:\n")
  cat("  1. Use multiple imputation.\n")
  cat("  2. Include significant predictors as auxiliary variables.\n")
  cat("  3. Report complete-case analysis as sensitivity check.\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6: Save results
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

dropout_results_obj <- list(
  dropout_n               = sum(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality),
  completer_n             = sum(SIMOA$dropout_before_personality == 0),
  dropout_proxy_check     = dropout_check,
  partial_completer_check = partial_check,
  continuous_comparisons  = if (length(continuous_results) > 0)
                              do.call(rbind, continuous_results) else NULL,
  categorical_comparisons = if (length(categorical_results) > 0)
                              do.call(rbind, categorical_results) else NULL,
  logistic_results        = if (exists("dropout_results")) dropout_results else NULL,
  sig_predictors          = sig_predictors,
  outcome_related         = outcome_related
)

saveRDS(dropout_results_obj, "dropout_diagnostics_results.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: dropout_diagnostics_results.rds\n")

if (!is.null(dropout_results_obj$continuous_comparisons)) {
  write.csv(dropout_results_obj$continuous_comparisons,
            "dropout_continuous_comparisons.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("✓ Saved: dropout_continuous_comparisons.csv\n")
}

if (!is.null(dropout_results_obj$categorical_comparisons)) {
  write.csv(dropout_results_obj$categorical_comparisons,
            "dropout_categorical_comparisons.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("✓ Saved: dropout_categorical_comparisons.csv\n")
}

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DROPOUT DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```
